strings.App.Title: Subtitle Studio — Audio extraction · Speech recognition · Subtitles
strings.Dialog.SelectMedia: Select a video or audio file

strings.Error.FfmpegMissing: ffmpeg was not found, so audio cannot be played
strings.Error.ImportFontDetail: cannot read font information from this file — try another .ttf / .otf

strings.Lang.Picker.Heading: Choose your language

strings.Preview.Empty: The subtitle preview appears here after recognition
strings.Settings.AutoSave: Changes are saved when the window closes
strings.Settings.Custom.Model: Model (type it in; after a connection test you can also pick it from the model menu)
